info.title: IS / Nexus Unified Tenancy Consumer API
info.description: Review draft only. Nexus policy/consumer APIs and proposed Identity service/exchange profiles; no Stage 2 implementation or deployment. Exact issuer/resources configured per environment. See ../NEXUS-CONSUMER-API-CONTRACT.md for normative delegation, privacy, freshness, and release gates.

servers.description: Placeholder only; pin verified environment resource/issuer and discovered OAuth endpoints before release.

post.summary: Resolve only an authorized canonical tenant
post.description: Exactly one ID/domain. Domain requires current association-specific approval. Human requires effective self access; service requires explicit tenant grant plus app/entitlement. Uniform 404 for unknown/hidden/suspended/uninitialized/unapproved.

get.summary: Discover effective tenants for self and calling application
get.description: Active initialized tenants, active self membership, active caller app and enabled entitlement only. Empty list does not disclose hidden counts. No userId/applicationId query selection.
Current token subject only. Hidden/inactive/unknown contexts return identical 404; no roster or arbitrary user lookup.

post.summary: Evaluate self access to calling application
post.description: Target application must equal active caller binding. Actor derives only from human access token. Generic 200 denial for all inaccessible contexts. Positive decision must be consumed within 5s of snapshot plus local resource checks.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact configured HTTPS consumer BFF origin; no null/missing origin or cookie authentication.

get.description: Own app only and effective tenant visibility, membership/workload grant as applicable. Missing/disabled/hidden entitlement gives generic 404, never a billing/configuration oracle.

post.summary: Evaluate explicit workload or verified delegated actor access
post.description: Own Nexus-audience service credential is mandatory. With actor evidence, validate incoming receiver audience/live family/tenant/human membership/entitlement and operation. Without evidence, exact workload tenant/operation grant required. Never fall back from failed evidence to workload.

post.summary: Create self-bound root delegation policy grant
post.description: Exact source client/key/jti and verified self actor, canonical tenant, allowlisted ordered edges and current membership/entitlements. Root reference alone is not authority. Max 120s/subject expiry. No token issuance here.

post.summary: Revoke visible root and all descendants
post.description: Only root human owner under bound source caller, or authorized recorded active participating service. Same 404 for missing/hidden grants. Idempotent for authorized family. Serialized with exchange; durable audit required.

post.summary: Identity OAuth token endpoint: proposed Stage 2 profiles
post.description: Use the discovered token_endpoint; this path reflects current /api/auth mounting and must be confirmed, never hard-coded by consumers. Models only the proposed client_credentials/exchange profiles, not the existing authorization-code endpoint contract. private_key_jwt and DPoP are mandatory in the request; security:[] does not mean anonymous issuance. No runtime change is made by this spec. Exchange remains disabled until vetted provider compatibility and Nexus policy are proven.

200.description: Profiled token issuance; no refresh/ID token

400.description: OAuth request/grant/resource/proof error; no hidden policy details

DPoPAccess.description: One exact configured resource audience; current issuer/client/principal/grant checks. No human ID tokens, cookies or Bearer fallback. Scope/class ceilings are documented per operation.

ResourceReference.description: Opaque application-local reference; Nexus never fetches it or proves resource ownership. Consumer must resolve it to the same canonical tenant.

Membership.description: Own visible active membership snapshot only. It is not an authorization credential or an application resource role.

tenant.description: Monotonic decimal epoch, represented as a string to preserve precision.

application.description: Monotonic decimal epoch, represented as a string to preserve precision.

entitlement.description: Monotonic decimal epoch, represented as a string to preserve precision.

consumerGrant.description: Monotonic decimal epoch, represented as a string to preserve precision.

version.description: Monotonic decimal epoch, represented as a string to preserve precision.
Monotonic decimal epoch, represented as a string to preserve precision.

EffectiveEntitlement.description: Visible calling-application entitlement only. Missing/disabled/inaccessible pairs return uniform 404; access decisions provide generic denials. No billing fields.

AllowedDecision.description: Fresh eligibility only; local resource authorization is still mandatory. membershipVersion is required for human actors and absent for workload actors. validUntil <= evaluatedAt+5s and all credential/grant expiries.

DeniedDecision.description: Uniform outcome for inaccessible/unknown/suspended/uninitialized/unentitled/nonmember contexts. No existence, actor, tenant, version or diagnostic details.

DecisionRequest.description: Stage 2D human-only profile. No actor/user selection or resource-level Story/Canon/Scene authorization. Own application and registered operation only.

ActorEvidence.description: Verified incoming delegation access token whose audience equals the authenticated receiving caller resource; used only as evidence under a live root/parent/receiver binding. Never an ID token or arbitrary subject assertion.

ServiceDecisionRequest.description: Without evidence, explicit workload tenant/operation grant is required. Invalid human evidence never falls back to workload mode. Target application must match authenticated caller binding.

domain.description: Validated ASCII DNS A-label hostname only; no IP/URL/port/trailing dot/wildcard. Must match a live approved association. Host/forwarded headers are not used.

DelegationEdge.description: Exact ordered server-allowlisted edge; resource ceiling, if supplied, is immutable/narrowable and must be enforced by receiving app.

DelegationGrant.description: Reference only, not a credential. Bound to verified source token jti/client/key and exact path. Max 120 seconds, not renewable.

Error.description: No tenant-specific diagnostics, raw inputs, tokens, SQL or secrets.

TokenResponse.description: Client credentials: no refresh or ID token; one Nexus audience, <=60s.

ExchangeResponse.description: Single receiving audience; same human/tenant, verified act/lineage/cnf and narrowed approved edge. No refresh/ID token; bounded by all ancestors.

resource.description: One exact registered resource URI; no array or repeated resources.

ClientCredentialsRequest.description: Explicit confidential service client, private_key_jwt and DPoP required. Only operator-approved client-credentials scope ceiling and tenant grants; no human subject parameter.

resource.description: One exact registered resource URI; no array or repeated resources.

ExchangeRequest.description: RFC8693 restricted profile with nexus_grant_id extension; actor_token, ID-token subjects, arbitrary actors/tenants and refresh are unsupported. Caller authenticated; root/parent receiver binding and exact edge policy required.

DelegatedTokenContext.description: Signed issuer-generated urn:nexus:authorization:v1 claim on delegated access tokens only. Never accepted as an unsigned request context or a replacement for live lineage/epoch checks.

DPoPProof.name: DPoP
DPoPProof.description: RFC9449 proof for current URL/method/key. Protected-resource calls additionally bind the access-token hash; token issuance has no access-token hash. Shared replay check and nonce policy; vetted verification only.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque authenticated/server-stored cursor bound to caller, subject and query. Max age 5m; never a grant.

BadRequest.description: Malformed or unknown fields; no actor/header substitution.

Unauthenticated.description: Invalid/missing credential or proof; no resource lookup.

schema.description: RFC9449 DPoP challenge; no token details.

Forbidden.description: Valid credential lacks endpoint scope/class; evaluated before resource lookup.

Unavailable.description: Absent or inaccessible target; identical generic error for hidden resources.

DependencyUnavailable.description: Gate dependency, Identity, audit, policy or replay store unavailable; never stale allow.
